about.lead:
Hi, I'm {firstName}. I like figuring things out —
and then building something with what I learn.
paragraphs: I'm developing my skills across programming and web development, focusing on the fundamentals and putting them to use through hands-on work. Right now, that means exploring full-stack development, machine learning, and intelligent applications.

There’s a lot I don't know yet.
That’s the exciting part.

projects.name: TraceRisk
projects.tagline: A little clarity. A better journey.
projects.description: An AI-assisted travel workspace for India. Plan trips, explore disruptions, and follow source-linked insights before heading out.
projects.detail: Combines local news, travel advisories, weather, and route information in one workspace. Travelers can plan multi-stop trips, compare options, inspect original evidence, and share a trip briefing.

projects.name: Team Board
projects.description: A real-time task board that keeps student teams in sync, from the first idea to the final handoff.
projects.detail: A collaborative workspace built with React and Supabase. Tasks stay synchronized across clients without a refresh. Version checks, editing indicators, and locks help teams handle simultaneous changes.

readme.guideText: The guide answers questions about my background and projects using the information I've shared here and in my project documentation.
